description.text: Ten single attacks (1.70 each), grants [Attach Earth], [Quick Cast 1], [Earth Quick Cycle] and [Inherited Essence Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Earth Quick Cycle
description.text: Grants [Quick Cast 1] after using a Earth ability

description.name: Inherited Essence Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Inherited Essence after using a Earth ability
